body:
Verified 70 did not fix it via a live SIP REGISTER probe. Pulled Asterisk's own res_pjsip_registrar.c source: the registrar requires an AOR's section name to literally equal the REGISTER username/username@domain/username@realm -- a descriptively-named AOR (carepyre-phone-aor) can never match, causing every registration to 404 regardless of the aors= value. Fixed PARENA's templates (renamed to [1000]/[1000web]) and wrote sudo-queue/71 to apply the same rename live + verify with a real end-to-end SIP REGISTER (not just a config dump). Not yet run. PARENA commit b1f9fbe, MONOREPO commit 48beaff.

⚓ ☃
title: Found the real Asterisk registration bug (70's fix was a no-op): AOR section names must match the extension
